status.en: 74 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 35% more than the week before, most of them in Sanaa, Mokha and Marib.
status.nb: 74 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 35 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Sanaa, Mokha og Marib.

summary.en: Houthi forces have escalated the conflict by striking Riyadh airport, killing twelve people—including an airline captain—and wounding hundreds, prompting the airport’s closure and widespread condemnation. The attack has triggered fresh warnings against using Saudi airports and airspace, while fighting expands in Yemen’s capital and other cities. Saudi and coalition forces have vowed a decisive response, heightening regional tensions. The conflict remains deadly, with 918 battle‑related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Houthi‑styrkene har eskalert konflikten ved å angripe Riyadh‑flyplassen, der tolv personer – inkludert en flykaptein – ble drept og hundrevis såret, noe som har ført til flyplassens stenging og bred fordømmelse. Angrepet har utløst nye advarsler mot bruk av saudiske flyplasser og luftrom, mens kampene utvides i Yemen‑hovedstaden og andre byer. Saudi‑ og koalisjonsstyrker har lovet en avgjørende respons, noe som øker spenningen i regionen. Konflikten er fortsatt dødelig, med 918 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Yemeni civil war (2014–present)
background.extract: The Yemeni civil war is an ongoing multilateral civil war that began in late 2014 mainly between the Rashad al-Alimi-led Presidential Leadership Council and the Mahdi al-Mashat-led Supreme Political Council, along with their respective supporters and allies. Both sides claim to constitute the official government of Yemen while the Presidential Leadership Council is recognized by the United Nations as the official government.
